title: OpenCodeHookInput
description: Input from the OpenCode execution hook.

session_title.description: Session title from opencode (may be absent).

tool_match_input.description:
Canonical fields used only for typed matching. The original tool input
remains intact for review, delegation, and attended request digests.

OpenCodeTool.description: Tool name as sent by OpenCode (lowercase). Known: bash, codesearch, doom_loop, edit, external_directory, glob, grep, list, lsp, multiedit, question, read, skill, task, todowrite, webfetch, websearch, write.

SessionId.description:
Opaque session identifier.

Wraps a `String` with `#[serde(transparent)]` so the JSON wire format
stays a bare string — no migration needed for TypeScript plugins, shell
scripts, or persisted state files.
